Package paint.ui.dialogs.project

Class BottomBarPanel

java.lang.Object
paint.ui.dialogs.project.BottomBarPanel
public class BottomBarPanel extends Object
Bottom bar panel containing Save Experiments, Verbose toggle, optional Sweep toggle (TRACKMATE), and OK/Cancel buttons. The controller registers callbacks using onOk(), onCancel(), onVerboseToggle(), and onSweepToggle(). This panel handles wiring the Swing events into those callbacks and updating UI state (running, completed, enabled, etc.).
